newsitem.title: ITALY: San Paolo details portfolio changes.
newsitem.headline: San Paolo details portfolio changes.

text.p: Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino said it had approved a reorganisation of assets with its holding company which would bring the institute a net positive financial effect of 414 billion lire.

A San Paolo statement said the institute would acquire 113.77 billion lire worth of minority interests in banking activities from Sanpaolo Bank Holding Spa as part of a reorganisation of its share stakes.
The banking institute would in return sell stakes in activities worth 220.80 billion to the holding.

"The reorganisation envisages the acquisition on the part of the institute of minority interests in banking companies and the sale by the institute to the holding of non-strategic stakes in credit activities," it said.
At the same time as transferring the stakes, the holding would reimburse the institute 307 billion lire for exposure of subsidiary Immobiliare Colonna '92.
In total, it said, the institute would therefore have a net positive financial effect of 414 billion lire.
Financial settlement for the transfer of stakes will take place on June 27 and on July 10 for reimbursement of the exposure.
